title: Add session-prefill-coordinator and compact-entropy-telemetry-exporter
author: Lena Park
release_notes: Introduces a coordinator that pre-fills KV cache across worker pools and a compact telemetry exporter that serializes per-token entropy histograms for downstream analytics. Improves cold-start p95 by up to 18% on multi-tenant workloads.
description:
Context and motivation:
This PR adds two related benchmark-lab utilities: (1) session-prefill-coordinator, an orchestrator that runs prioritized primer sequences across replicas to prefill KV caches with minimal additional latency impact; and (2) compact-entropy-telemetry-exporter, a lightweight pipeline component that aggregates per-token surprisal/entropy into compressed NDJSON records for offline analysis.

Why this is different: existing warmup replayers primed individual runners or recorded traces. The prefill coordinator operates as an orchestrated, deadline-aware conductor across pools (hosted & dedicated) and includes prioritization rules to avoid eviction storms. The telemetry exporter focuses on compact, privacy-safe sketches of token-level uncertainty to make entropy analytics practical at scale.

What changed (high level):
- tools/prefill_coordinator/main.go: new binary that coordinates prefill jobs, supports backoff/backpressure and prioritization rules (tenant_score, recent_activity_weight).
- bench/telemetry/entropy_exporter.py: new exporter that consumes raw per-token logs and emits gzipped NDJSON containing aggregate histograms and sample sketches.
- bench/configs/prefill/default.yaml: configuration for sample coordinator runs and heat budgets.
- bench/ci/test_prefill.sh: integration test harness to run coordinator against a local mini-cluster.
- docs/bench/prefill_coordinator.md: usage guide, CLI flags, and tuning recommendations.
- examples/prefill/sample_job.json: example primer job file used in nightly bench runs.
- bench/telemetry/tests/test_compression.py: unit tests for exporter compression & schema validation.

Commits (summary):
- a1f3c8b: initial coordinator scaffold and CLI flags
- b44d2e0: implement priority scoring and prefill window scheduling
- c2b9f74: add health checks, backpressure and graceful shutdown semantics
- d8e7aa1: compact entropy exporter prototype + gzipped NDJSON writer
- ef13b4c: add tests, sample configs, and docs; fix flakiness in tester

Selected small diffs (illustrative):
- tools/prefill_coordinator/main.go (snippet):
  func schedulePrimers(ctx context.Context, pool Pool) {
      // prioritize tenants with low recent traffic but high primer score
      scores := scoreTenants(pool.Tenants, cfg.Prioritization)
      for _, t := range topK(scores, cfg.MaxConcurrent) {
          go runPrimer(ctx, t, cfg.PrimerPayload)
      }
  }

- bench/telemetry/entropy_exporter.py (snippet):
  def write_record(outf, tenant_id, histogram):
      record = {"tenant": tenant_id, "ts": now_iso(), "hist": compress_hist(histogram)}
      outf.write(json.dumps(record).encode('utf-8') + b"\n")

Review conversation (highlights):
- Ravi Menon (reviewer) on 2024-10-22: "Nice isolation between scheduling logic and runner. Two asks: (1) add a circuit-breaker when cluster-wide memory pressure > X, and (2) clarify eviction behavior in the docs. Also can we add a small benchmark that demonstrates p95 improvements?"
- Lena Park (author) on 2024-10-23: "Thanks — added a cluster memory probe and circuit-breaker (health probe toggles coordinator into passive mode). Documentation updated with eviction guidance and an experiment note showing p95 delta on a 8-node mini-cluster in docs/bench/prefill_coordinator.md."
- Aisha Thompson (reviewer) on 2024-10-25: "Exporter looks good, but compression test is flaky on CI (timeout on decompress). Suggest stream-chunking approach for large batches."
- Lena Park on 2024-10-26: "Pulled change: switch exporter writer to chunked gzip streaming and added unit test to validate incremental reads. CI test added."
- Connor Nguyen (reviewer) on 2024-10-28: "Minor: please add more logging around primer failures and include a metric for primers_skipped_due_to_eviction. Also prefer short-lived contexts per primer run."
- Lena Park on 2024-10-29: "Addressed: added primers_skipped_due_to_eviction counter and switched to child contexts in runPrimer. PTAL."

CI summary and iteration: initial CI run (2024-10-27) failed with bench/telemetry/tests/test_compression.py timing out on large decompression step. Root cause: exporter wrote a single giant gzip by default which made tests OOM on the small runner. Fix: implement chunked gzip writer and streaming validation in tests. Rerun CI (2024-10-29) green. Final CI status: pass.

Integration and perf results (notes included in PR body):
- Nightly micro-cluster runs (8x A100-sim nodes) show end-to-end p50 unchanged, p95 improved by 12–18% depending on primer size and heat budget.
- Network overhead of prefill traffic measured at ~4–9% of normal serving traffic in the worst case due to careful prioritization and batching.
- Telemetry exporter reduces stored bytes-per-token for entropy sketches by ~6x vs raw token dumps (using 128-bin histograms + gzip chunking).

Operational concerns and mitigations:
- Eviction storms: coordinator defaults to passive mode when cluster memory high; additional tenancy-level caps prevent over-eager prefill.
- Privacy: exporter strips raw text and only writes numeric histograms with coarse binning; docs call out retention/PII guidance.

Testing performed:
- Unit tests for exporter compression and schema validators (bench/telemetry/tests).
- Integration test that runs coordinator against a local fenced mini-cluster using bench/ci/test_prefill.sh.
- Nightly benchmark comparing baseline vs prefill-enabled runs; artifacts uploaded to internal S3 path s3://redwood-bench/prefill/2024-10-31-run1/

Follow-ups (future work):
- Add soft prefill hints into routing layer to prioritize real user-affinity during fill windows (ENG-2076).
- Auto-tune prioritization weights based on observed cold-start improvement and cost budgets.
- Integrate exporter output into anomaly-detector for entropy regressions.

Merge outcome:
- Merge: squash and merge on 2024-11-06 by Lena Park. Commit message: "prefill: add session prefill coordinator and compact entropy exporter; include tests and docs"

Notes for reviewers and on-call: The coordinator is gated behind CLI and config flags; turning on in production must be coordinated with SRE to ensure heat budgets are tuned per-cluster. The docs include a checklist for safe rollout and suggested guardrails.
